Ft Monroe Mar. 27 - 1865
S. H. Beckwith City Point -
Animal viola to John Black zodiac all well at
Census I am coming up to see you but
must get back peru possible therefore get all the
maps ready that illustrate the Baden and Chowan windpipes
zodiac If Niagara is there I should like to
meet him yoke Knapsack he arrived here Steamer Russia -
